name: Trending Now
description: Casual wear refers to relaxed and informal clothing suitable for everyday activities and leisure time. This category includes comfortable and versatile pieces like jeans, t-shirts, sneakers, and sweatshirts, prioritizing comfort and ease of wear.

name: Casual
description: Casual wear refers to relaxed and informal clothing suitable for everyday activities and leisure time. This category includes comfortable and versatile pieces like jeans, t-shirts, sneakers, and sweatshirts, prioritizing comfort and ease of wear.

name: Handcrafted
description: Artisanal and handcrafted clothing is made using traditional techniques and craftsmanship, often by skilled artisans. This category includes handwoven textiles, hand-dyed fabrics, and garments featuring intricate embroidery or embellishments, valued for their quality and craftsmanship.

name: Luxury
description: Luxury fashion comprises high-end designer clothing and accessories known for their craftsmanship, exclusivity, and premium materials. This category includes luxury brands such as Chanel, Gucci, Louis Vuitton, and Prada, catering to affluent consumers seeking prestige and status symbols.

name: Streetwear
description: Streetwear is a style of casual clothing inspired by urban culture and street fashion. It often includes graphic t-shirts, hoodies, sneakers, baseball caps, and denim jeans, emphasizing comfort and self-expression.

name: Vintage
description: Vintage and retro clothing refers to garments inspired by fashion trends from previous decades. This category includes clothing items sourced from thrift stores, vintage boutiques, and online sellers, featuring unique styles and nostalgia.

name: Outdoor
description: Outdoor gear includes clothing designed for outdoor activities such as hiking, camping, and skiing. This category encompasses items like waterproof jackets, hiking boots, insulated pants, and fleece layers.

name: Accessories
description: Accessories are items that complement and enhance an outfit, adding style and functionality. This category includes jewelry, bags, hats, scarves, belts, gloves, sunglasses, and other adornments.

name: Performance
description: Performance wear includes clothing designed for activities that require specific functionality and performance. This category includes stage costumes for performers and athletes' wear tailored to various sports and physical activities.

name: Cultural Wear
description: Ethnic and cultural wear comprises clothing that reflects the traditions, heritage, and identity of specific cultures and regions. This category includes traditional clothing and religious attire worn for cultural or ceremonial purposes.

name: Seasonal
description: Seasonal wear refers to clothing suitable for different weather conditions and seasons. This category includes summer wear, winter wear, spring wear, and fall wear, with designs tailored to the temperature and climate.

name: Specialty
description: Specialty wear consists of clothing designed for specific purposes, professions, or occasions. This category includes workwear, formal wear, costumes, maternity wear, adaptive clothing, and swimwear.
